securityCorrectness: The adapter invokes npm with fixed run/check arguments and shell disabled, surfaces spawn errors and terminating signals, and preserves child exit status. The delta changes no dependencies, lockfiles, audit surface, or plugin trees.
designMaintainability: The package script, Node adapter, system QA, decisions, and design align: bun run ci crosses a narrow wrapper into canonical npm run check without recursive Bun rewriting. Dockside and all main-owned plugin trees are unchanged.
